interpretation.claim: Two 224-of-256 expert-per-layer Qwen3.5-family GGUF candidates were evaluated on the complete pinned WikiText-2 raw test split using the same CPU runtime settings. Both failed the configured 98% point-estimate PPL-retention floor.
interpretation.ranking_conclusion: The random seed 20261026 candidate has a 1.2113 lower PPL point estimate than router-norm selection on this one model and corpus. The llama.cpp propagated uncertainty bands do not overlap, but are not formal confidence intervals; this single comparison does not establish that random selection is generally better.
limitations: The configured point-estimate PPL retention floor is 0.98; both 224-expert candidates fall below it.
The reported plus/minus values are llama.cpp propagated uncertainties, not formal confidence intervals or a significance test.
This is one model, one dataset, one router-norm selection, and one random seed. It does not establish task-quality retention or general ranking superiority.
No throughput, latency, model load time, peak RAM/VRAM, or energy measurement was made for these 224-expert artifacts.
llama.cpp reports some model tensors as unused while evaluating this architecture. Runs completed with return code 0, but runtime and task compatibility beyond this PPL evaluation remain unverified.
